## Checklist

- [ ] `./mvnw -B -ntp verify` passes (unit, contract and integration tests).
- [ ] The contract tests pass without changes to them (see "The message contract" in CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] Changed behaviour is covered by a test.
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md has a line for changes users notice; README.md is updated if configuration or behaviour changed.
- [ ] No passwords, tokens or other secrets in code, tests or log output.
